svg.title: Three spatial models, one observed frame
svg.desc: Metrica open sample · nominal 105 × 68 m grid · home-side control share Home: circles · Away: triangles · Ball: diamond. Attacking direction is unknown. Frame nearest the median Gaussian/arrival difference among all 240 samples; no accuracy ground truth. Finite-coordinate tracking; supplier detection flags unavailable. Metrica Sports open data.
